Our Services | BLESSINGS TRUCK & TRAILER REPAIRS | Home | About Us | Services | Contact Us | Reviews | Get a quote | Get a quote | Home | About Us | Services | Contact Us | Reviews | CONTACT US | Services | SCHEDULE YOUR REPAIR WITH US TODAY! | Scheduling a repair with Blessings Truck & Trailer Repair body shop ensures your trucks and trailers will receive top-quality repair and maintenance from experienced professionals, leaving you with peace of mind and reliable transportation for your business. | Trailer Body Repairs | Trailer body repair involves the restoration of damaged or worn-out parts of a trailer. The process includes assessing the damage, removing the damaged area, repairing or replacing parts, and finishing with a fresh coat of paint. This type of repair is essential to keep trailers in good working condition and ensure safe transportation of goods. Expert technicians with experience in trailer repair should be consulted to handle trailer body repairs. | BOOK SERVICE | Floor Repair & Replacement | Flat bed floor repair and replacement is a crucial part of maintaining the safety and longevity of a flatbed truck. Over time, the constant weight and movement of cargo can cause damage to the flooring, resulting in cracks or weakened support. Repairing or replacing the floor will ensure that the truck remains structurally sound and able to safely transport heavy loads. Trusting a professional with experience in flat bed floor repair and replacement is essential to ensuring the job is done safely and correctly. | BOOK SERVICE | Major Collision Repair | Major collision repair refers to the process of repairing a large commercial truck after it has been involved in a severe accident. This type of repair can involve replacing or repairing many components of the unit. It is essential to have these repairs done professionally to ensure the safety and reliability of the truck and prevent any further damage. An experienced collision repair technician can help restore your truck to its pre-accident condition, getting you back on the road safely | and efficiently. | BOOK SERVICE | Landing Gear Assembly | The landing gear on trailer s may fail for a variety of reasons including corrosion, damage, or trailers being utilized beyond their life expectancy. It is important to note also that landing gear failures could be attributed to frequent side-to-side, back-and-forth, and up-and-down movements due to fork truck loading and unloading. We can repair or replace your landing gear to ensure your trailer will stand safely when you need it. | BOOK SERVICE | Door Repair & Replacement | Truck door repair and replacement are common services required by truck owners. Over time, wear and tear can cause damage to truck doors, such as dents, scratches, or broken hinges. These damages can affect the overall functionality and security of the vehicle, making it important to resolve any issues as soon as possible. Professional truck door repair and replacement services can help restore damaged doors to their proper condition, ensuring they function as intended and provide optimal security. With the right services, truck owners can enjoy safe and reliable transportation for their goods and equipment. | BOOK SERVICE | Frame & Structural Repair | Truck frame and structural repair includes repairing damages to the frame and other major components of a commercial truck. The frame is the backbone of the truck, providing it with the strength and stability it needs to carry heavy loads. Damage to the frame can compromise the safety and structural integrity of the entire vehicle. Frame and structural repair involves straightening, welding, or replacing damaged sections of the frame and other key parts of the truck's structure like the top and bottom rails. This type of repair work requires specialized equipment and experienced technicians who are trained in specifically working on commercial vehicles. Proper frame and structural repair is essential to keeping a truck in good working condition and extending its lifespan. | BOOK SERVICE | Lighting & Electrical | Truck lighting and electrical systems are essential for the safe and efficient transportation of goods and materials. The lighting system of a truck is responsible for illuminating the road and warning other drivers of the presence and intention of the truck. It includes headlights, tail lights, turn signals, brake lights, and hazard lights. The electrical system, on the other hand, provides power to these lighting systems as well as other components such as the radio, air conditioning, and navigation system. A well-maintained electrical system ensures that all electrical components are functioning correctly, reducing the risk of breakdowns and accidents on the road. | BOOK SERVICE | Welding & Fabrication | Welding and fabrication refer to crafting and repairing the metal structures of trucks and trailers. Welding involves fusing metal parts with heat and pressure, while fabrication is the process of creating metal structures from raw materials. Our team of professionals are experienced in working with various metal alloys and can provide customized solutions to meet the specific requirements of our clients. | BOOK SERVICE | Roof Repair & Replacement | Truck and trailer roof repair and replacement is an important process for ensuring the safety and integrity of a commercial vehicle. Over time, the roof of a truck can become damaged due to exposure to harsh weather conditions, collisions, or wear and tear from carrying heavy loads. When this occurs, it is essential to have the roof repaired or replaced by a professional service provider to prevent further damage or accidents on the road. Repairing or replacing a truck's roof can also prevent further damage to the interior of the unit. | BOOK SERVICE | Decal Removal & Installation | Truck Decal Removal & Installation is an important process in maintaining the aesthetic appeal of a truck. Decals can add personality, style, and advertising to a truck. But, when it's time to remove or update those decals, a skilled technician can make the process quicker and easier. Decals may be removed with a variety of tools, depending on the type of decal, adhesive, and the surface underneath. Once the decals are removed, the surface is prepared for a new decal installation. This includes cleaning and possibly repairing scratches, dents, or paint chips. | BOOK SERVICE | Business Hours | Mon - Fri | 8:00 am - 5:00 pm | Saturday | 8:00 am - 12:00 pm | Sunday | Closed | Data Privacy Policy | Contact | (689) 266-9962 | & | (407) 591-0731 | BTTR@BlessingsTrailerRepair.com | 4525 E Wetherbee Rd. | Orlando FL 32824 | Get a Quote | © 2026 | All Rights Reserved | Created with ZING.work | Share by:
